join hortbot 999 foobar 1


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add notexist (_THISDOESNTEXIST_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'notexist' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!notexist hello
send hortbot #foobar [HB] (_THISDOESNTEXIST_)


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test "(_PARAMETERA_)"
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "(_PARAMETERA_)"

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test "(_PARAMETER__)"
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "(_PARAMETER__)"
